# Kinetic type

Typography takes the lead; motion is an optional accent.

## Use

Use for short messages, campaign headlines, and editorial title sequences.

## Essential traits

- Typography-led hierarchy
- Deliberate line breaks
- Motion limited to headings

## Typography

Large bold system sans-serif headlines; readable sans-serif body.

## Layout and surfaces

Oversized heading rhythm, strong line breaks, minimal decoration. Clean solid panels with short optional heading entrance.

## Palette

- background: #f7f4ed
- surface: #fffdf8
- text: #242820
- muted: #5e6259
- accent: #755225
- border: #c9c9bb

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Kinetic type to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Large bold system sans-serif headlines; readable sans-serif body. Oversized heading rhythm, strong line breaks, minimal decoration. Clean solid panels with short optional heading entrance. Palette: background #f7f4ed, surface #fffdf8, text #242820, muted #5e6259, accent #755225, border #c9c9bb. Essential traits: Typography-led hierarchy; Deliberate line breaks; Motion limited to headings. Avoid: Animated body text; Reading before text settles; Motion required to understand the message. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
